item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00137","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C23","C03","C14"],"selected_candidate_label":"C23","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C23 is a strong reusable template for the child. Both proclamations concern a concession in Part I of Schedule XX to the same General Agreement, establish that the concession’s duty has been applied since January 1, 1948, recite a Tariff Commission investigation into increased imports causing or threatening serious injury to a domestic industry, invoke Article XIX, and operatively modify the concession for the identified tariff item. The child adapts this machinery to section 7 of the 1951 extension act, a different item and rate, and a later effective date. C03 is the next-closest item-specific tariff-modification proclamation but rests on an inadvertent drafting error rather than serious-injury safeguards. C14 uses related GATT concession-modification machinery but combines several distinct matters and is less directly parallel.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"products described in the said item 1520 are... being imported into the United States in such increased quantities as to cause serious injury to the domestic industry producing like or directly competitive products","parent_excerpt":"such products are being imported in such relatively increased quantities and under such conditions as to cause or threaten serious injury to the domestic industry producing like or directly competitive products","explanation":"Distinctive shared safeguard finding concerning increased imports and serious injury to producers of like or directly competitive products."},{"child_excerpt":"the United States Tariff Commission has submitted to me its report of an investigation and hearing... [and] recommended that the concession... be modified","parent_excerpt":"the United States Tariff Commission has made an investigation... [and] has transmitted to me a report of its findings and has recommended... the withdrawal in whole of the tariff concessions","explanation":"Both use the same administrative sequence: Tariff Commission investigation and hearing, findings and report, then a recommendation to alter a specified concession."},{"child_excerpt":"in accordance with the provisions of Article XIX of the said General Agreement, do proclaim... That the concession... shall be modified","parent_excerpt":"to withdraw the tariff concessions... in accordance with the provisions of the said Article XIX of the said General Agreement","explanation":"Both expressly ground the product-specific concession adjustment in Article XIX of GATT."},{"child_excerpt":"the rate of duty which shall be applied to the products described in the said item 1520 entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption after the close of business February 8, 1952","parent_excerpt":"on and after December 1, 1950, it shall be applied as though item 1526(a) in Part I of Schedule XX of the said General Agreement were stated as follows","explanation":"The operative machinery is materially parallel: amend the treatment of one Schedule XX item from a specified effective date so that a revised duty applies to covered imports."}]}
